name: Rosewood Phuket
positioning: Beach resort of pavilions, houses and villas on a 600-meter beachfront at Emerald Bay, Phuket
best_for: Families and couples wanting a beach resort with private plunge pools
Travelers who want spa treatments and farm-to-table dining

facts.text: Rosewood Phuket sits along a 600-meter beachfront on Emerald Bay.
Accommodation is a collection of pavilions, houses and villas beside the white sands of Emerald Bay.
Lagoon Pool Pavilions have Andaman Sea views and a private plunge pool.
Partial Ocean View Pool Pavilions have floor-to-ceiling windows, a plunge pool and an outdoor bathtub.
Ta Khai serves traditional Southern Thai cuisine made with local ingredients and a zero-waste commitment.
Red Sauce is an Italian restaurant with views over Emerald Bay.
Mai is a poolside lounge for daytime pool time and evening cocktails, with views of Emerald Bay.
The Shack serves simply prepared seafood poolside.
Complimentary water sports equipment includes kayaks and SUPs.
The resort has dedicated padel courts.
Excursions include ethical elephant encounters, Old Town, yacht trips to Phang Nga Bay and helicopter flights.
The resort offers sound therapy with Tibetan singing bowls.

highlights.text: The Ocean House has Emerald Bay views, a private pool, garden terraces and courtyards.
Ta Khai uses produce from its own organic herb and vegetable garden.
Guests can take a guided tour of the organic Little Bukit Farm followed by a zero-mile tasting dinner.
The resort has a free-form infinity pool that merges with the waters of the bay.
Condé Nast Traveler says the Andaman Sea is visible from everywhere in the resort.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the bungalows are spread up and down the hillside, with pools, spa, bars and restaurants scattered throughout.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation for exploring.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Rosewood Phuket review
